name: Why is proper preparation crucial before painting window trim?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper preparation crucial before painting window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial because it ensures a smooth, durable, and long-lasting finish for your window trim. Without adequate cleaning, sanding, and priming, paint may chip, peel, or show imperfections quickly. At Maine Results, Inc., we emphasize meticulous preparation to protect your home's exterior and enhance its curb appeal for years to come.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper preparation ensures a smooth, durable, and long-lasting paint finish, preventing chipping or peeling.
